verdict.rationale: Brex documents multi-level approval flows routed automatically by amount, vendor and employee role (brex-docs-11), plus policy rules defining who needs to approve (brex-docs-8), which covers the core multi-step chain. Escalation is evidenced only as an AI review agent escalating policy exceptions (brex-docs-16), not as escalation when an approver sits on a request, and delegation is not mentioned at all. Missing for 10: approver delegation, time-based escalation of stalled approvals, explicit manager/budget-owner/finance chain roles, multi-level approvals documented outside bill pay, independent corroboration.
